Update the standalone-guide test when moving this heredoc to `RUNNER_TEMP`. The required validation suite extracts and executes this exact script in `source-release-security-rc16-publish.test.cjs`, but creates the guide under its temporary `reports/source-release-rc16` directory without setting `RUNNER_TEMP`; locally `path.join` throws on `undefined`, and on GitHub's runner it instead reads a nonexistent runner-temp file. Consequently the `validate` job's mandatory test command fails before this release can publish.
